figures.finding: A director must be a natural person at least eighteen years of age.
figures.applies: Malaysia, Companies Act 2016 (Act 777), as at 31 January 2025, s. 196(2).

sources.said: 196. (1) A company shall have a minimum number of directors as follows: (a) in the case of a private company, one director; or (b) in the case of a public company, two directors. (2) A director shall be a natural person who is at least eighteen years of age. || 235. (1) A company shall have at least one secretary who shall be— (a) a natural person; (b) eighteen years of age and above; and (c) a citizen or permanent resident of Malaysia,
